Video Production Studio v0.4.2

Nineteen video methods with a Python renderer, timeline interchange, Loom walkthroughs and review packets.

Download v0.4.2 ZIPOpen the original release

Record notes

Nineteen video methods with a Python renderer, timeline interchange, Loom walkthroughs and review packets.

Version 0.4.2 includes 19 complete skill procedures. Complete standalone runtime and methods; separate Video Templates MCP is optional.

Requirements: Python >=3.10; FFmpeg with drawtext; FFprobe; A usable font for typography.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add video-production-workflow@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from fa4f68d5883a99971983ed9a7d874bc6e8993ec6. SHA-256: 6d5137af59d75ef8fc5ca9f8d525303c1a19f5c153d475516e349a61f836aaff.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
